title: VictoryHoldResumed
description: A paused victory hold gained progress again: no hold node is under pressure any more (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §9; ECONOMY EC-9b, Q-TD-84 (b); NX-466). Emitted on the first running tick after a VictoryHoldPaused with no hold node pressured, which also gains 1. Not emitted when the hold breaks or the campaign ends during the pause. Only with campaign.victory.pause_on_pressure. Public, like VictoryHoldStarted.

ends_at_tick.description: The running tick the victory comes on if nothing pauses or breaks the hold again: this running tick + victory_hold_ticks - progress_ticks (campaign clock, as VictoryHoldStarted.ends_at_tick).

progress_ticks.description: The progress after this tick's gain.
